remarks: Welcome to South Norwalk, an ideal living destination boasting stylish dining and shopping just moments away. Step into this bright and spacious townhouse with an inviting open floor plan, perfect for entertaining. The kitchen features a center island and gleaming hardwood floors. Upstairs, discover two generous bedrooms and a bathroom on the second floor. The upper level unveils a luxurious Master suite with ample closets and a master bath. Enjoy the convenience of a 2-car garage with direct access to the lower level, equipped with a washer, dryer, and a convenient half bath. Embrace the vibrant community atmosphere, making this residence a fantastic place to live and relish dining, entertainment, and all that this dynamic neighborhood has to offer.
